notes:
v4.6.107 — IBKR equity/value charts now show the full timeframe

📈 Fixed: on IBKR, the portfolio value curve only ever showed the last day and ignored the time-period selector. The 'ALL' period was silently collapsing to a single day, so the value line sat under trade events that spanned weeks. Now 'ALL' plots the whole recorded history and every period (1D/1W/1M/…) calibrates correctly, so the value line and the trade-event markers line up on the same timeline.

🟢 Also includes the header server-reachability indicator (green '● server' = cloud reachable, red '● offline' = network issue) so you can tell a network blip from a real problem — your cloud bots keep trading on Oracle either way.

Update via the in-app banner.
